operations.label: Dry fruit at room temperature
operations.description: SI Figure S1 supplies room temperature; drying time and humidity are unreported.

operations.label: Chop the dried fruit
operations.description: Chop the dried material into small pieces; dimensions are unreported.

operations.label: Carbonize in a muffle furnace
operations.description: Carbonize the chopped biomass at 300 °C for 3 h in a muffle furnace. Atmosphere, ramp, crucible and cooling are not reported.

operations.label: Grind the carbonized solid
operations.description: Grind with a mortar and pestle to a fine powder. Particle-size cutoff is not given.

operations.label: Disperse powder in ultrapure water
operations.description: Ultrasonically disperse a 100 mg aliquot of carbonized powder in 100 mL ultrapure water. Time, power and temperature are unreported. This 1 mg/mL precursor loading is not isolated CQD concentration.

operations.label: Separate larger solids
operations.description: Centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 15 min. Rotor radius and relative centrifugal force are unreported. Retain the supernatant; discarded solid is a separate characterization context.

operations.label: Filter the supernatant

quality.review_scope: Prior independent source audit covers 12 main and 107 matched SI pages. Root independently accepted the bounded DLS/NMR corrections and checked the current-schema projection against that accepted extraction. One CQD route; application products remain separate contexts. Presentation pending.

conflicts: Preparation disperses 100 mg carbonized powder in 100 mL water before separation; catalytic solution is 24 mg/mL without reported concentration/isolation step. Handling: Store precursor loading and catalytic concentration separately. Isolated CQD mass/yield and concentration method remain unknown.
Preparation prose 0.22 µm membrane; Figure S1 drawing 0.2 µm. Handling: Prose procedure 0.22 µm with conflicting diagram value attached.

SI prints (0.2×0.5)/10=0.008 N; arithmetic gives 0.01 N. Conductometry uses 12 mL and reports 0.00833 N separately. Handling: Do not replace the reported value; retain displayed calculation and distinguish assays.
Main assigns low binding-energy O1s ~531.2 eV to C=O and high ~532.4 to C-OH; Table S2 reverses these group assignments. Handling: Keep each interpretation with its source locator.

SI prose carbonyl 162.35 ppm is absent from Figure S6 labelled peaks 161.298/159.630/...; main text uses isotope 19C while figure caption uses 13C; native/tagged CQD identity also ambiguous. Handling: 13C technique from caption, source typo retained. Do not assert unique molecular structure or native/tagged aliquot match.
Main prose says DCM failed; Figure 5c shows a high DCM yield spoke. Handling: No numerical DCM yield extracted; retain graphical/prose discrepancy.

Scheme 2 lists 11a: 60%*/78%# and 11b: 71%*/85%#, with text methods A/B; no A/B definitions or asterisk legend found in supplied main/SI. Handling: Retain paired yield variants with unresolved method association. Do not infer microwave conditions from instrument listing.

Coumachlor SI procedure names benzylideneacetone, while Scheme 2 R=Cl and product drawing require chlorinated aryl context. Handling: Literal precursor and chlorinated product both retained; no silent reagent substitution.

Main general claim of simple filtration/no chromatography conflicts with SI drug procedures using silica chromatography. Handling: Filtration-only statement applies to scaffold-family procedures; drug workups are separate.
Scheme S2 six-series branch labels NaN3 10 mmol, 0.46 g; four-series branch labels 10 mmol, 0.64 g. Handling: Retain both printed amounts; do not use 0.46 g as a validated 10 mmol conversion.
Scheme S2 reports 9a atom economy 86.93%; detailed SI 33 calculation reports 95.53%. Handling: Separate reported metric contexts.

4e/6e/8e/9e titles say 4-hydroxyphenyl; drawings show 3-bromophenyl and listed masses belong to brominated series. Handling: Retain literal names, source-labelled product IDs and drawn interpretation; molecular identity unresolved.
4g/6g/8g/9g titles say 4-fluorophenyl; drawings show 2-bromophenyl and listed masses are brominated. Handling: No resolved molecular model or automatic formula normalization.
SI 51 labels a trimethoxy structure/data 9f, duplicating 9i, whereas Figure S8 depicts 9f as dichloro. Handling: Keep 9f scope yield separate; characterization identity unresolved.
SI 52 indanedione phenoxy entry is printed 8h; spectrum captions 94–95 label 9h. Handling: Contextual inventory ID 9h is an explicitly marked inference; raw printed 8h retained.

8j title SI 48 says hydroxynaphthalenone but drawing is coumarin; 4d spectrum captions 65–68 similarly say hydroxynaphthalenone while SI 35/main Figure 6 show coumarin. Handling: Retain source-labelled identities; do not merge scaffold names silently.

Scope drawings can place phenoxy at a different ring position from the 3-phenoxy names/drawings in characterization (especially 8h Figure S8). Handling: Do not infer exact regioisomer from family letter alone; retain source-specific drawing pointers.

Main 6a CH doublets 6.47–6.48/6.49–6.50 ppm conflict with SI 39 ranges 8.48–8.45/7.60–7.57 ppm; 4a main 6.16 vs SI 34 typed 6.14 while spectrum 55 labels 6.160. Handling: NMR interpretation remains author attribution, not resolved tautomer proof.

SI 87 caption says 13C NMR of 9a, but visible 0–13 ppm trace, peak labels and integration resemble/reproduce the proton trace SI 86. Handling: Flag image as technique/caption inconsistent; do not use as valid 13C measurement. Typed 13C list SI 49 remains separately reported.
4b full proton spectrum SI 59 labels 9.935/6.141 ppm; extended SI 60 labels 9.999/6.205 ppm. Handling: Do not treat the extended display as a verified crop of the same acquisition.
Typed compound entries call MS EI, but supplied mass plots 58/68/77 display TOF MS ES+. Handling: Keep reported method per evidence item; no exact-mass validation claim.

Malformed literal tokens include 6h: 71.93.65, 8j: 139.87.1, 9c: 111,8; several distinct-product arrays duplicate. 9a 13C paragraph 75 MHz differs general 100 MHz. Handling: Retain raw characterization strings; no automatic decimal repair or spectral fitting.

4a: typed 168.03/164.72/36.10 ppm versus plotted labels 168.139/164.826/36.204 ppm. Both source versions are retained; no referencing-offset correction is assumed. Handling: Unresolved text/plot discrepancy. Preserve alternatives with exact locators; do not validate the numerical spectrum or silently correct values.

6d: typed 8.86–8.54 ppm versus plotted cluster 8.565–8.543 ppm. The typed proton list omits the plotted 3.827 ppm singlet (integral approximately 3). No peak-list repair or methoxy assignment is substituted for the source. Handling: Unresolved text/plot discrepancy. Preserve alternatives with exact locators; do not validate the numerical spectrum or silently correct values.

8b: typed 163.27/162.03/153.73/38.02 ppm versus plotted labels 162.275/161.036/152.736/37.024 ppm. The typed carbon list duplicates 8a; preserve both source versions without assuming a uniform correction. Handling: Unresolved text/plot discrepancy.
